name: Letrozole (endocrine maintenance)
cyclesNote: continuous once-daily oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity (cycleLengthDays 1 represents continuous daily dosing).

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer / Low-grade serous (general reference)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT endocrine option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

biomarkers.note: Low-grade serous carcinoma frequently expresses estrogen/progesterone receptors; aromatase inhibition is a well-tolerated maintenance or relapse option in postmenopausal (or ovarian-suppressed) patients.

supportiveCare: Aromatase inhibitors accelerate bone loss: baseline and periodic bone-density monitoring, calcium/vitamin D, and bone-directed therapy where indicated.
Counsel on arthralgia, hot flushes and lipid effects.

drugs.name: Letrozole
drugs.notes: Letrozole 2.5 mg PO once daily, taken continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity, for hormone-receptor-positive low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (adjuvant/maintenance or indolent relapse). Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
